headline: Mexico Sets Dates for El Buen Fin 2026 Discount Weekend
summary: Mexico's nationwide discount weekend, El Buen Fin, is scheduled for November 13-17, 2026, with projections of $12.5 billion in sales.
why: El Buen Fin is a major retail event in Mexico designed to stimulate domestic consumption and boost commercial sector revenues.

impacts.name: Retail
impacts.why: Nationwide discounting events typically drive temporary surges in consumer spending and retail revenues.
